name: FlowDim 05
detailed_description:
About This Game

Flowdim05 is a side-scrolling action roguelike with JRPG elements, set in a near-future world on the edge of a technological breakthrough.

You play as Q, a former medical student who developed a mental illness after using an experimental brain-machine interface. His career shattered, Q stumbles upon a black market forum where underground drug research offers a glimmer of hope. Determined to find a cure, he faces one major obstacle: no money.

To fund his research, Q turns to a mysterious, high-risk virtual game rumored to reward real-world cash. Inside, players explore randomized environments, fight monsters, and collect powerful relics. These relics can be sold to earn the funds needed for medicine development.

Switching between virtual battles and real-world struggles, Q must fight, grow stronger, and gather the materials necessary to create a cure—not just for himself, but for others like him.

Flowdim05 blends fast-paced combat, roguelike replayability, and a narrative about illness, survival, and self-discovery.

Features

  • Fast-paced Side-Scrolling Combat: Agile controls, combo systems, and epic boss battles challenge your skills.

  • Procedurally Generated Environments: Every exploration brings unique terrain, monster combinations, and rewards.

  • Relic System: Defeat enemies to collect rare relics that enhance abilities or can be sold for resources.

  • Dual-World Mechanism: Balance between real-world research and virtual in-game resource gathering.

  • Story-driven Experience: Uncover Q's past and the mysteries of the world through main quests and character interactions.

short_description: FlowDim05 is a side-scrolling action roguelike. Travel between the real world and a mysterious mindscape, defeat twisted monsters, collect relics, and fund medicine research. Can you break the cycle and save yourself across two overlapping realities?
